{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Identify duplicate patient_ids and keep only the row with the highest sample_seq
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Verify the cleaning
print(f"Number of patients after deduplication: {trial_df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check for any remaining sentinel values
print(f"Sentinel values in biomarker_baseline: {trial_df['biomarker_baseline'].isin([-999.0]).sum()}")
print(f"Sentinel values in biomarker_final: {trial_df['biomarker_final'].isin([-999.0]).sum()}")

# Check the distribution of arms and severity
print("\nDistribution of arms:")
print(trial_df['arm'].value_counts())
print("\nDistribution of severity:")
print(trial_df['severity'].value_counts())"}
